> Per-turn cost is mean context: cache-read is the bulk of main-loop spend and
> fresh input is a rounding error. The BRIEF row is the floor a turn cannot go below;
> the distance from it to LONG is session length rather than work. **That distance is
> a bound, not a saving** — realising any of it needs a cheap cold start, which is what
> the plan, the derived state and the cluster packs are for.

> **2 models in this measurement.** The unit above counts tokens, not money,
> so a total mixing model tiers understates the expensive ones. Per model:
